title: Stocks slide on flare-up in Middle East fighting; oil eases off highs
title_zh: 中东战火加剧，股市下跌；油价从高点回落
summary: By Gregor Stuart Hunter SINGAPORE, June 4 (Reuters) - Asian stocks fell on Thursday as renewed fighting between the U.S. and Iran rattled investors, although oil slipped from recent highs after Israel
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 6 月 4 日 - 由于美国和伊朗之间的新一轮战斗令投资者感到不安，亚洲股市周四下跌，但以色列之后油价从近期高点回落

title: Meta accuses Australia of breaching FTA, invokes US 'trade action'
title_zh: Meta指责澳大利亚违反自由贸易协定，援引美国的“贸易行动”
summary: SYDNEY, June 4 (Reuters) - Meta accused Australia of violating a free trade agreement with the U.S. by proposing a new tax on certain tech giants which do not strike licensing deals with local media,
summary_zh: 路透悉尼 6 月 4 日 - Meta 指责澳大利亚提议对某些未与当地媒体达成许可协议的科技巨头征收新税，违反了与美国的自由贸易协定。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip as Iran war threatens to drag on
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌，因伊朗战争可能持续下去
summary: US stock futures slipped as doubts about President Trump’s ability to end the war with Iran rattled Wall Street.
summary_zh: 由于对特朗普总统结束与伊朗战争的能力的怀疑令华尔街感到不安，美国股指期货下跌。

title: Why a broader market could mean trouble for growth stocks
title_zh: 为什么更广泛的市场可能会给成长型股票带来麻烦
summary: Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton sits down with Stifel Vice President, Portfolio Strategy Thomas Carroll to discuss the risk of market broadening on growth.
summary_zh: 《市场支配加班》主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 与 Stifel 投资组合策略副总裁托马斯·卡罗尔 (Thomas Carroll) 坐下来讨论市场扩大对增长的风险。

title: What's justifying SpaceX's $2T valuation target ahead of IPO?
title_zh: SpaceX 在 IPO 前设定 2T 美元估值目标的理由是什么？
summary: According to Reuters, SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) is gunning for an IPO date of Friday, June 12, with hopes to begin trading on the Nasdaq at $135 per share. This could launch the value of Elon Musk's private space operator to $2 trillion.
summary_zh: 据路透社报道，SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 计划于 6 月 12 日星期五进行 IPO，希望以每股 135 美元的价格在纳斯达克开始交易。这可能会使埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的私人太空运营商的价值达到 2 万亿美元。

title: Used Cybertrucks are in demand, but that won't move Tesla stock
title_zh: 二手赛博卡车需求旺盛，但这不会影响特斯拉股价
summary: Tesla's (TSLA) first official Cybertruck inventory sold out in 24 hours. Barron's associate editor Al Root explains why and addresses whether the Cybertruck has any bearing on Tesla's stock.
summary_zh: 特斯拉 (TSLA) 首批官方 Cyber​​truck 库存在 24 小时内售罄。 《巴伦周刊》副主编 Al Root 解释了原因，并讨论了 Cyber​​truck 是否对特斯拉的股票有任何影响。

title: Apple's new feature takes the pain out of splitting the check
title_zh: 苹果的新功能消除了分摊支票的痛苦
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma and Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferre join Josh Lipton on Market Domination to discuss Apple's (AAPL) new feature to split bills by taking a photo of a receipt.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛 (Brooke DiPalma) 和高级商业记者伊内斯·费雷 (Ines Ferre) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起讨论《市场统治》，讨论苹果公司 (AAPL) 通过拍摄收据照片来分摊账单的新功能。

title: Apple CEO Tim Cook explains why he's stepping down
title_zh: 苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克解释了他辞职的原因
summary: Apple CEO Tim Cook explains why he's stepping down.
summary_zh: 苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克解释了他辞职的原因。

title: Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet are about to spend a shocking amount of money to dominate the AI era
title_zh: Meta、微软、亚马逊、Alphabet 即将斥巨资称霸 AI 时代
summary: The spending on AI has only just begun.
summary_zh: 人工智能方面的支出才刚刚开始。
